project: GroupPass verified attraction and group-pricing database
method: Existing curated records are retained as trusted seed data. New major attraction candidates are found with attraction-specific web searches and ranked by repeated search prominence. Directory, review, social, and booking aggregators are excluded as database sources. A new venue is accepted only after an official venue-domain page confirms a group program. Official group pages are fingerprinted and rechecked; stale exact prices are hidden or removed when they cannot be re-verified.
activationRequired: Add BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY as a GitHub Actions repository secret, then run Refresh verified GroupPass catalog once.
